title: Odika Chicken
description: Odika Chicken is a Gabon classic prepared with chicken thigh, yellow onion, ground egusi, tomato. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Ground egusi approximates Gabonese odika (wild mango seed), which is not in the ingredient catalog.

steps.instruction: Pat the main ingredients dry. Brown in a hot heavy pan in batches for about 12 minutes, turning to color all sides.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 45 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
